usage: 炒雞翼 is a noun that refers to a dish made by stir-frying chicken wings.
You can use 炒雞翼 to talk about what you want to order or what dishes are available at a restaurant.
It can serve as the subject or object in a sentence when discussing food.
炒雞翼 is often combined with measure words like 碟 to indicate a serving or plate of the dish.
It can be used with verbs like 想, 食, or 叫 when ordering or talking about food.
